According to the question,

Total candidates appeared in 1991 = 8562

Total candidates appeared in 1992 = 8139

Decrease in percentage of candidates,

P% = [1 - (8139/8562)] × 100

⇒ P% = [1 - 0.95] × 100

⇒ P% = 0.05 × 100 = 5%

**∴ The percentage drop in the no. of semi-urban candidates is 5%.**
